title: Slicing theorem (Simon §4, 4.4–4.10)
statement: For all P, m, open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ D_{m+1}(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ and M_W(∂T) < ∞ for all W ⊂⊂ U, and every f : ℝ^P → ℝ which is L-Lipschitz on U, there is a family S_t ∈ D_m(U) (t ∈ ℝ) with: (i) IsSlice T f t S_t, i.e. S_t = ∂(T⌞{f<t}) − (∂T)⌞{f<t}, for every t; (ii) spt S_t ⊆ spt T ∩ {f = t} for every t; (iii) if T is integer multiplicity, S_t is integer multiplicity for L¹-a.e. t; (iv) for every open W ⊆ U, every L_W ≥ 0 with ‖Df‖ ≤ L_W Lebesgue-a.e. on W, every a < b and every R with IsRestriction T {x ∈ U : a < f x < b} R, there is a measurable g : ℝ → [0,∞] with M_W(S_t) ≤ g(t) for all t ∈ (a,b) and ∫_{(a,b)} g ≤ L_W·M_W(R).
